text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? I know that voice...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dad, Mom... I miss you two so much. I know I was lookin' forward to today, but... Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no, Taiki is crying! I wonder what
happened...
I should say something.)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... Sniff. I need me a bit of exercisin' to shake off these blues...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...What if something terrible has
happened?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Taiki has always cheered me
up, so
today, it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Something sweet should make her happy... I'll bake a cake! I have to make this work!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? I don't have any whipped cream
on me! I
m-must have forgotten to buy
some?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah?! Is that smoke coming out of the
oven?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... It all turned out a disaster... I
can't give
her a cake like this...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, I...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's already twilight... and I'm still blue...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... Do you mind if I stay by your side?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doto... Sniff. Of course you can.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't able to see my mom and dad.
We made
plans 'n all, but work had to
come first...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniff. Sorry 'bout all this. We should find somethin' else to talk about!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...N-no, it's not that. I just, um... Um...
Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I'm so soooorry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doto?! What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hic! You're having such a hard time, but... I haven't done... anything for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really w-wanted... I really wanted to
help you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Now now, Doto...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might be lookin' like a leaky faucet,
but hearin'
you say that made me happy.
With you by my
side, I feel warm and
fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hic! But... But...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Would you be so kind as to close your
eyes, my
dear?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, did you... wipe my tears for me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Seein' as we're two crybabies, I reckoned
it'd do
us good to wipe each other's
tears.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-Taiki... Sniff. Maybe you're right...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I suppose it's my turn now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch, Doto. ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm leaving out the academy gates, I
happen to
see Meisho Doto and Taiki
Shuttle. Their eyes are
so red. Were they
crying?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, n-not at all! If anything, this is the
opposite
of a fight.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn tootin' it is! I'll show ya what we're
up to. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All righty! First one to stop holdin' hands
is gum
on a boot heel! Hehe, let's hurry
on home!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Happy tears... I kind of like that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet! ♪ Makes sense seein' as we
enjoyed lots
of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's right! Lots... and lots of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on the events of the day,
the two
exchange smiles. I'm sure
they've made a
wonderful memory
together.
